title: VoiceProfile
description: A character voice profile. Separate from character identity and from sound assets. Requires explicit authorisation + rights/consent. v2.5 ADDITIVE MIGRATION (CF-WO-P0-006 Addendum C §5): Voice Profile data added (voice_profile_id, source, audio_reference_assets, accent, vocal_characteristics, pitch_range, speaking_pace, pronunciation_preferences, emotional_delivery_range, model, approval_status, consent_status). All new fields are optional; no existing required field was removed or retyped, so every valid v2.3 record remains valid. Voice profiles are private, owner/workspace-scoped, and bound to exactly one character (character_id) — never shared across characters or users, and never sent to a provider without disclosing that transmission. CF-WO-P0-007 Correction B/C: structured 'ownership' (owner_id + workspace_id + visibility + sharing) is REQUIRED for v2.5 records, enforced conditionally by scripts/asset_policy.py validate_voice_profile — the repo's JSON-Schema validator subset has no if/then, allOf or dependentRequired, so the JSON Schema alone cannot express conditional-required and stays permissive here; a record is fully valid v2.5 only when both the schema and the Python validator pass. For v2.5 the minimum fields are voice_profile_id, character_id, source, ownership, voice asset references, approval_status and consent_status, with source-conditional rules (user-recording: audio reference + granted consent; ai-generated: provider + model identification + approval state). consent_status governs consent and must agree with consent.granted; consent_status 'not-required' is legitimate only when human_voice_donor is false. approval_status is 'pending' until the user explicitly approves — a generated voice is never approved automatically, and only an approved, correctly owned profile may be selected for production. Provider transmission must be disclosed, approved and recorded (provider_transmission); nothing here promises data never leaves the device.

voice_profile_id.description: Voice Profile ID (Addendum C §5). Stable ID for this voice profile; the same ID is referenced from character.voice_profile_ids, performance-plan lines and script-to-performance character_voice_bindings so VoiceStudio receives a consistent handoff.

source.description: Where this voice came from: user-recording (the user/owner recorded reference audio) or ai-generated (synthesised voice, no human voice donor). Provider limits for AI-generated voices must be disclosed to the user.

audio_reference_assets.description: Reference audio assets for this voice (recordings/samples). Pointers only — relative path + optional hash; the audio itself lives in the private overlay, workspace-scoped.

accent.description: Accent/regional colour of the voice, e.g. 'Dhaka Bengali', 'General American'.

vocal_characteristics.description: Timbre and character of the voice, e.g. 'warm, bright, slightly breathy'.

pitch_range.description: Usable pitch range of the voice, e.g. 'high, child female'.

speaking_pace.description: Default speaking pace for this voice.

pronunciation_preferences.description: Pronunciation preferences, e.g. per-language sound rules or words that need special care.

emotional_delivery_range.description: Emotions this voice can deliver (subset of the performance emotion vocabulary).

model.description: Voice model used (e.g. 'OmniVoice'). Distinct from model_version, which pins the model build.

ownership.description: Structured private ownership. owner_id + workspace_id are stable, opaque, randomly generated local identifiers — never a real name, email or account detail. visibility is private by default; sharing is none by default and requires an explicit future sharing permission.

human_voice_donor.description: Whether a real person's voice was used as the donor for this voice (recorded, or cloned from a real person). True: explicit permission + granted consent are required. False: no real person's voice was used; consent_status 'not-required' is legitimate only with this field false. Absent: donor status unrecorded, so 'not-required' is not legitimate.

approval_status.description: Whether this voice profile is approved for use in productions.

consent_status.description: Consent state for this voice. A user-recorded voice requires granted consent; an AI-generated voice with no human donor is not-required only when no real person's voice was used (human_voice_donor false) — never use 'not-required' to bypass actual permission requirements.

provider_transmission.description: Disclosure record for voice data sent to a provider. Voice data must never be sent to a provider without disclosing that transmission, user approval, and the provider + data-use scope. This record must never promise that data never leaves the device; it records what was disclosed and approved for this transmission.
